aliases: 5MP+5MP Dual-lens Wi-Fi Indoor Pan & Tilt Network Camera
features: dual-lens: fixed wide lens + motorized pan & tilt zoom lens (Pan 0-349, Tilt -5 to 90)
auto tracking with linkage between fixed and PT lens
smart dual light: IR up to 50 m (PT) / 30 m (fixed), warm light up to 40 m (PT)
two-way talk, microSD up to 256 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua Hero H5D is a 5MP+5MP dual-lens indoor mains-powered Wi-Fi pan & tilt camera pairing a fixed wide lens with a motorized zoom PT lens, auto tracking, smart dual-light night vision and AI human/pet detection. Verified against the official Dahua product page.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi dual-lens pan-tilt camera managed via the DMSS app; ONVIF/RTSP is not stated. Add via the Generic Camera integration if RTSP is exposed.
